correctness.rationale: At the pinned RESULT.md, the Segre hyperplane class H=sum h_i has intersection number N!/prod(a_i!), while the CW-cell decomposition of each complex projective factor gives chi=prod(a_i+1). Dividing yields the exact coordinate-ratio (N+1)/(a_j+2). For r>=3 every increment strictly raises the quotient; for r=2, (1,b) stays at 1/2, (2,b) gives (b+2)/6, and every pair with both entries >=3 is >=R(3,3)=5/4. With r=3 the base (1,1,1) gives 3/4 and (1,1,2) gives 1; for r>=4 r!/2^r >1. Therefore equality is only (2,4) or (1,1,2), and the stated strict cases exhaust all positive-dimensional factors. Independent exact integer enumeration of sorted tuples r<=5, dimensions 1..6 returned these same equality tuples.
